stories.title: Spring at the Haft-Sin Table
stories.culturalNote: Nowruz marks the first day of spring. Families gather around the Haft-Sin table as the new year arrives.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: امروز روز اول بهار و نوروز است.
sentences.finglish: emruz ruz-e avval-e bahâr o Nowruz-e.
sentences.english: Today is the first day of spring and Nowruz.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: همهٔ خانواده در خانهٔ مادربزرگ جمع شدند.
sentences.finglish: hame-ye khânevâde tu-ye khune-ye mâdarbozorg jam' shodan.
sentences.english: The whole family gathered at Grandma's house.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: روی میز، سبزه و سیب قرمز و سکه هست.
sentences.finglish: ru-ye miz, sabze o sib-e ghermez o sekke hast.
sentences.english: On the table, there are sprouted greens, red apples, and coins.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: یک ماهی قرمز هم توی تنگ آب شنا می‌کنه.
sentences.finglish: yek mâhi-ye ghermez ham tu-ye tong-e âb shenâ mikone.
sentences.english: A little red goldfish also swims in the glass bowl of water.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: بابابزرگ لبخند می‌زند و می‌گوید: عیدتون مبارک!
sentences.finglish: bâbâbozorg labkhand mizane o mige: Eydetun mobârak!
sentences.english: Grandpa smiles and says: Happy New Year!

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: ما با هم چای و شیرینی می‌خوریم و خیلی خوشحالیم.
sentences.finglish: mâ bâ ham chây o shirini mikhorim o kheli khoshhâlim.
sentences.english: Together we have tea and pastries, and we are very happy.

stories.title: Candlelight on Yaldâ Night
stories.culturalNote: On Shab-e Yaldâ, Iranians stay up sharing stories, ruby pomegranates, and poetry from Hâfez.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: امشب شب یلدا است، بلندترین شب سال.
sentences.finglish: emshab shab-e Yaldâ-st, bolandtarin shab-e sâl.
sentences.english: Tonight is Yaldâ Night, the longest night of the year.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: بیرون سرد است ولی توی اتاق خیلی گرم و روشن است.
sentences.finglish: birun sard-e vali tu-ye otâgh kheli garm o roshan-e.
sentences.english: Outside it is cold, but inside the room it is very warm and bright.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: مامان انارهای قرمز و هندوانهٔ شیرین آورد.
sentences.finglish: mâmân anârhâ-ye ghermez o hendune-ye shirin âvord.
sentences.english: Mom brought ruby-red pomegranates and sweet watermelon.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: روی فرش کنار هم نشستیم و آجیل خوردیم.
sentences.finglish: ru-ye farsh kenâr-e ham neshastim o âjil khordim.
sentences.english: We sat together on the Persian rug and ate roasted nuts.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: پدربزرگ کتاب حافظ را باز کرد و یک شعر زیبا خواند.
sentences.finglish: pedarbozorg ketâb-e Hâfez ro bâz kard o yek she'r-e zibâ khund.
sentences.english: Grandpa opened the book of Hâfez and read a beautiful poem.

sentences.speaker: NARRATOR
sentences.farsi: همه گفتند: دستت درد نکنه، شب خیلی قشنگی بود!
sentences.finglish: hame goftan: dastet dard nakone, shab-e kheli ghashangi bud!
sentences.english: Everyone said: thank you, it was such a lovely night!

stories.title: Calling Mâmânbozorg (Two Voices)
stories.culturalNote: Listen to the two voices: Nima speaks in an upbeat younger voice, while Mâmânbozorg replies in a warm, gentle voice.

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: الو، سلام مامان‌بزرگ! من نیما هستم.
sentences.finglish: alo, salâm mâmânbozorg! man Nimâ hastam.
sentences.english: Hello, hi Grandma! It's Nima.

sentences.speaker: GRANDMA
sentences.farsi: سلام عزیز دلم! قربون صدات برم، حالت چطوره؟
sentences.finglish: salâm aziz-e delam! ghorbun-e sedât beram, hâlet chetore?
sentences.english: Hello, sweetheart! How lovely to hear your voice, how are you?

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: من خوبم، مرسی. شما چطورید؟ چیکار می‌کنید؟
sentences.finglish: man khubam, mersi. shomâ chetorid? chikâr mikonid?
sentences.english: I'm good, thanks. How are you? What are you up to?

sentences.speaker: GRANDMA
sentences.farsi: داشتم چای می‌خوردم و به یادت بودم، پسرم.
sentences.finglish: dâshtam chây mikhordam o be yâdet budam, pesaram.
sentences.english: I was having tea and thinking of you, my dear boy.

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: مامان‌بزرگ، دلم براتون خیلی تنگ شده. جمعه میام پیشتون!
sentences.finglish: mâmânbozorg, delam barâtun kheli tang shode. jom'e miyâm pishetun!
sentences.english: Grandma, I miss you so much. I'm coming to see you on Friday!

sentences.speaker: GRANDMA
sentences.farsi: قدمت رو چشم! به مامان و بابا سلام برسون. خداحافظ.
sentences.finglish: ghadamet ru cheshm! be mâmân o bâbâ salâm beresun. khodâ hâfez.
sentences.english: You're always welcome! Say hi to Mom and Dad. Goodbye.

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: خداحافظ مامان‌بزرگ، مراقب خودتون باشید!
sentences.finglish: khodâ hâfez mâmânbozorg, morâgheb-e khodetun bâshid!
sentences.english: Goodbye Grandma, take good care of yourself!

stories.title: Tea & Saffron at the Bazaar
stories.culturalNote: At a traditional Persian bazaar, friendly ta'ârof and warm small talk go hand in hand with shopping.

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: سلام آقا، ببخشید، این چای ایرانی چنده؟
sentences.finglish: salâm âghâ, bebakhshid, in chây-e irâni chand-e?
sentences.english: Hello sir, excuse me, how much is this Persian tea?

sentences.speaker: GRANDMA
sentences.farsi: سلام، خوش آمدید! قابل شما رو نداره، پنجاه تومنه.
sentences.finglish: salâm, khosh umadid! ghâbel-e shomâ ro nadâre, panjâh toman-e.
sentences.english: Hello, welcome! Please take it as a gift—it's 50 toman.

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: لطف دارید! خیلی خوب و ارزونه. دو بسته می‌خوام.
sentences.finglish: lotf dârid! kheli khub o arzun-e. do baste mikhâm.
sentences.english: That's kind of you! It's very good and affordable. I'd like two packs.

sentences.speaker: GRANDMA
sentences.farsi: چشم، بفرمایید! نوش جان!
sentences.finglish: cheshm, befarmâyid! nush-e jân!
sentences.english: Of course, here you go! Enjoy!

sentences.speaker: NIMA
sentences.farsi: خیلی ممنون، دستتون درد نکنه. خداحافظ!
sentences.finglish: kheli mamnun, dastetun dard nakone. khodâ hâfez!
sentences.english: Thank you very much, appreciate it. Goodbye!
